raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions casts both the same way. As a result, v2 transactions are shifted 6 hours later (CST in January), which pushes evening sales into the 00:00-06:00 window and onto the next txn_date (e.g. 31 phantom rows on 2026-01-19). The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago local time, matching the historical legacy convention, before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) s WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
